fixed: Device Sync no longer gets stuck after you make a custom field private when a device running a newer version of the app had shared extra details about it. The private field is simply no longer shared, and if you make it shareable again, devices on the newer version lose the extra details they had added to it.

A private custom-field definition projects to an empty body whatever was kept for it for a newer version (spec section 6.7). The kept parts were merged into that empty body, which made the snapshot throw "body.id must be a non-empty string" on every pass; they are now swept with the record.
